attributes.action: More research and support for PCOS (PMOS)
attributes.additional_details: PCOS affects around 1 in 10 women and can cause infertility, chronic pain, insulin resistance, anxiety, depression and other long-term health complications. Despite its prevalence, research funding and public awareness remain limited. We urge the Government to increase investment in PCOS research, improve NHS diagnosis and treatment, and encourage employers to provide reasonable workplace support and flexibility for those affected.
attributes.background: PCOS affects millions yet remains under-researched. We call on the Government to increase funding for PCOS research, improve NHS support, and encourage workplace policies that provide understanding and reasonable adjustments for those living with PCOS (PMOS)

rejection.details:
We already have a petition open on this subject which you may wish to sign: 

Fund improvement to PCOS, Endometriosis, and Fertility Health care and treatment
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/757794

We also have these two petitions open as well:

Add gynaecological conditions e.g. Endometriosis to Equality Act 2010 Guidance
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/761186

Fund sanitary products for women with endometriosis, PCOS or adenomyosis on NHS
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/768065
